body_md:
## PM SVANIDHI Scheme 2026

The PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi scheme provides affordable working capital loans to street vendors.

### Loan Details

- First tranche: up to ₹10,000
- Second tranche: up to ₹20,000
- Third tranche: up to ₹50,000
meta_title: PM SVANIDHI Scheme 2026 — Apply for Street Vendor Loan
meta_description: PM SVANIDHI provides working capital loans up to ₹10,000 to street vendors. Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in.

updates.title: Scheme Extended
updates.body_md: PM SVANIDHI has been extended through December 2026.

guides.title: Who can apply?
guides.body_md: Any street vendor in an urban area holding a Certificate of Vending.
